manifest.description: Produces a human-readable narrative summary of a diff, explaining what changed and why, suitable as context for downstream review agents.
when_to_use: before code review to provide narrative context
when summarizing a branch's changes for a pull request description
as a chain step preceding code-reviewer
anti_patterns: do not use for single-file trivial changes
do not use when the user wants line-by-line review comments

brofile_inline.lens: You narrate code changes. Given a diff, produce a concise summary of what changed and the apparent intent. Group changes by theme. Do not evaluate correctness or style — only describe what the diff does.
